description: First-launch PURPOSE/INTENT picker (user item 1: 'when I open the app let me choose what I want, building or plants'). Reuse the existing SurveyPurpose enum (general, agriculture, building, wellDrilling, slopeStability) as the app-wide intent rather than inventing a parallel enum. Add a persisted provider that stores the chosen purpose, show a one-time purpose-selection screen at app start (after onboarding completes and after auth resolves, before the user lands on Home), map the chosen purpose to the initial Home tab, seed the GeoResearch survey purpose from it, and let the user re-choose it from Settings. All strings localized in EN + AR (fr/es fall back to EN).
steps: Add a pref key to lib/core/constants/app_constants.dart: 'static const String prefAppPurpose = 'app_purpose_v1';' near the other pref keys.

Create lib/features/onboarding/application/app_purpose_provider.dart with an AppPurposeNotifier extends StateNotifier<SurveyPurpose?> that reads LocalCacheService.getString(AppConstants.prefAppPurpose) in its constructor and maps it via surveyPurposeFrom (returning null when no value is stored so the picker shows once). Expose setPurpose(SurveyPurpose) that persists purpose.name via _cache.setString and updates state. Mirror the OnboardingNotifier pattern. Also expose a bool 'purposeChosenProvider' (or have the notifier hold null-until-chosen) so the router can tell 'not yet chosen' apart from a deliberately-chosen 'general'. Provider: appPurposeProvider = StateNotifierProvider<AppPurposeNotifier, SurveyPurpose?>. Import SurveyPurpose/surveyPurposeFrom from lib/features/georesearch/domain/site_survey_model.dart.

Add a helper mapping SurveyPurpose -> initial Home tab index in lib/features/home/application/home_provider.dart (e.g. 'int homeTabForPurpose(SurveyPurpose p)': building/wellDrilling/slopeStability -> HomeTab.georesearch, agriculture/general -> HomeTab.diagnose or HomeTab.chat). Keep it a pure function so it is unit-testable. Document the chosen mapping in a comment.

Create lib/features/onboarding/presentation/purpose_screen.dart: a ConsumerWidget/Stateful screen shown once. Present the five SurveyPurpose options as large, accessible ChoiceChips or cards using purposeLabel(p, l10n) for labels and the same icons used in survey_inputs_section.dart (explore_outlined, agriculture_outlined, foundation_outlined, water_drop_outlined, terrain_outlined). A title/subtitle explaining the choice, a confirm/continue button. On confirm: call appPurposeProvider.notifier.setPurpose(chosen), set ref.read(homeTabProvider.notifier).state = homeTabForPurpose(chosen), and seed GeoResearch via ref.read(soilResearchControllerProvider.notifier).setPurpose(chosen). Follow onboarding_screen.dart styling (SafeArea, AppSpacing, LeafLogo optional). Every string localized. No permission requests here.

Wire the router in lib/core/routing/app_router.dart: after onboarding and auth resolve to a signed-in user, if ref.watch(appPurposeProvider) == null return const PurposeScreen(); else HomeScreen. Keep the state-driven, flicker-free pattern (only branch on resolved values). Add the import.

Add a Settings entry in lib/features/profile/presentation/settings_screen.dart to re-choose the purpose: a section (localized header) with a RadioGroup<SurveyPurpose> or ListTile that opens the purpose options, using purposeLabel for each. On change: appPurposeProvider.notifier.setPurpose, and optionally update homeTabProvider and soilResearchControllerProvider purpose. Follow the existing RadioGroup pattern in that file.

Add ARB keys to BOTH lib/l10n/app_en.arb and lib/l10n/app_ar.arb (exact key parity): e.g. purposeScreenTitle, purposeScreenSubtitle, purposeScreenContinue, and a settings header settingsPurpose (or reuse georesearchPurpose). Do NOT duplicate the five purpose labels; reuse the existing georesearchPurpose* keys via purposeLabel. Add @-metadata entries mirroring neighbouring keys.

Hand-add every new key to all 5 generated files: abstract getter 'String get <name>;' in lib/l10n/app_localizations.dart (with the '/// No description provided for @<name>.' comment matching the surrounding style), and 'String get <name> => '...';' impls in app_localizations_en.dart, app_localizations_ar.dart, app_localizations_es.dart (English text), app_localizations_fr.dart (English text). Match dart format's two-line wrap for getters whose single line exceeds 80 columns.

Add tests in test/providers/app_purpose_provider_test.dart: (a) default is null when no pref stored; (b) setPurpose persists and state updates; (c) a new container restores the persisted purpose via surveyPurposeFrom. Use ProviderContainer(overrides: await defaultOverrides(prefs: {...})) with addTearDown(container.dispose). Add a unit test in test/unit/home_tab_for_purpose_test.dart asserting homeTabForPurpose maps each SurveyPurpose to the documented tab index.

Optionally add a widget test in test/widgets exercising PurposeScreen selecting 'building' and confirming (via pumpApp) that appPurposeProvider becomes SurveyPurpose.building and homeTabProvider becomes HomeTab.georesearch.
acceptance_criteria: A new signed-in user who has completed onboarding but not chosen a purpose sees PurposeScreen before Home; after choosing, subsequent launches skip it (purpose persisted).
Choosing 'building' (or wellDrilling/slopeStability) lands the user on the GeoResearch tab; the GeoResearch survey purpose is pre-seeded to the chosen value.
The purpose can be changed later from Settings and the new value persists.
app_en.arb and app_ar.arb remain at exact key parity after additions; every new key has an abstract getter and an impl in all 4 generated impl files (fr/es use the English string).

flutter test passes app_purpose_provider_test.dart and home_tab_for_purpose_test.dart (verified by the user); statically, brace/paren balance holds and the getter-coverage harness passes for the new keys.
No parallel intent enum introduced; SurveyPurpose is reused.
verification: python3 parity check on app_en.arb vs app_ar.arb (from FEAT-001) reports empty symmetric difference
python3 getter-coverage harness reports each new key present in all 5 l10n files
User runs: flutter pub get && flutter analyze && flutter test && dart format lib test integration_test

findings.summary: First-launch purpose picker implemented reusing the existing SurveyPurpose enum (no parallel intent enum). appPurposeProvider (StateNotifierProvider<AppPurposeNotifier, SurveyPurpose?>) persists purpose.name under AppConstants.prefAppPurpose='app_purpose_v1' and reads it back via surveyPurposeFrom in the constructor; null means 'not yet chosen' so the picker shows once. purposeChosenProvider (bool) lets the router distinguish null from a deliberately-chosen general. Router now returns PurposeScreen after auth resolves to a signed-in user when appPurposeProvider==null, else HomeScreen (flicker-free, branch-on-resolved-value). PurposeScreen shows the 5 SurveyPurpose options as accessible cards (icon + label + check/radio icon, selection NOT colour-only) using purposeLabel() and the survey_inputs_section icons; on Continue it calls setPurpose, sets homeTabProvider = homeTabForPurpose(chosen), and seeds soilResearchControllerProvider.setPurpose(chosen). Settings gains a RadioGroup<SurveyPurpose> section (header settingsPurpose) doing the same. homeTabForPurpose is a pure function: building/wellDrilling/slopeStability -> georesearch, agriculture/general -> diagnose.
findings.l10n: 4 new keys added to BOTH app_en.arb and app_ar.arb (real EN + real AR): purposeScreenTitle, purposeScreenSubtitle, purposeScreenContinue, settingsPurpose. No new purpose-label keys (reused existing georesearchPurpose* via purposeLabel). Hand-wired into all 5 generated files: abstract getters in app_localizations.dart + impls in _en (real EN), _ar (real AR), _es/_fr (English fallback). purposeScreenSubtitle wraps onto two lines to match dart format's 80-col behaviour; short getters stay one line. No @-metadata added (new keys have no placeholders, matching the file convention).
findings.verification: Static only (no Flutter SDK in sandbox). ARB parity check: parity OK 413 (was 409, +4). Getter-coverage harness: OK for all 4 new keys across all 5 l10n files. Brace/paren balance 0 0 on every edited/new Dart file. The user must run flutter pub get && flutter analyze && flutter test && dart format lib test integration_test on their toolchain.
findings.tests: Added test/providers/app_purpose_provider_test.dart (null default, setPurpose persists+updates, restore-from-prefs, deliberate-general != not-chosen, unknown-value degrades to general), test/unit/home_tab_for_purpose_test.dart (pure mapping per purpose + all map to valid tab), and test/widgets/purpose_screen_test.dart (select Building + Continue => appPurposeProvider=building, homeTabProvider=georesearch, soilResearch purpose=building). Used defaultOverrides(prefs:{...}) + ProviderContainer with addTearDown(container.dispose).
